scripts.pages:publish: npm run pages:publish:app && npm run pages:publish:wrapper
scripts.pages:publish:app: npm run build && npm run pages:clean && gh-pages -d dist -e app --add
scripts.pages:publish:wrapper: npm run pages:stage-terminal && npm run pages:clean && gh-pages -d terminal-wrapper -e terminal-wrapper --add
scripts.pages:stage-terminal: node -e "const fs=require('fs');for (const f of ['terminal.html','styles.css']) fs.copyFileSync('../backend/public/'+f, 'terminal-wrapper/'+f);console.log('staged terminal.html + styles.css into terminal-wrapper/')"
